verdict.line: You lose if you walk into an up Riposte or extend past level 10 before her Blade Waltz is down; you win if you bait her W, chain Q into double W, and out-sustain her Duelist stacks once your on-hit core lands.

brief.thesis: Fiora's whole trade pattern depends on baiting your stun or auto into an up Riposte (W) and using Lunge (Q)'s free second dash to disengage, while your Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range) outranges her 600-range Lunge and lets you threaten without ever touching her parry. The head-to-head win rate of 44.7% over 123 games sits below Volibear's overall 48.4% across 8,888 games, matching the measured edge to Fiora, but the even solo-kill rate confirms all-ins are winnable once you actually track her cooldowns instead of swinging blind.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and you're in melee range
theirWindow.what: Do not auto-attack or Thundering Smash into her while W is live; it parries your next basic attack and reflects magic damage. Poke with Sky Splitter (E) from its 1200 range instead and wait for the parry window to expire (10s at rank 1, down to 6s by rank 5).

yourWindow.when: Riposte and Lunge are both down
yourWindow.what: Commit Q (Thundering Smash, 12-10s cd) for the stun into W (Frenzied Maul), then immediately recast W on the same mark for bonus damage and a heal. This window opens right after she pokes with Lunge (16-8s cd) and has nothing left to punish your engage.

start.why: The mana pool lets you spam E (16s cd) and double-tap W (5s cd) through early trades without running dry, and the regen offsets her Duelist passive stacking off every poke.

boots.why: Fiora's damage is almost entirely basic attacks and on-hit from Lunge; flat reduction on autos blunts both her poke and her Blade Waltz follow-up autos after landing.

core.why: Attack speed and the proc damage let you stack your passive's bonus magic damage faster in extended trades, which is how you out-value her short burst windows.
Sustained damage and haste keep your Q/W rotation cycling fast enough to punish every time her Riposte goes down.
More attack speed compounds your on-hit passive stacks, turning drawn-out fights (which favor you once her Vitals are gone) decisively your way.
Boosts the heal on your double-tap W and your passive sustain, directly countering her Duelist regen in a race for who outlasts the trade.

situational.when: fiora's Duelist stacks are healing her through your all-ins and your burst isn't closing the fight
fiora snowballs ahead and starts threatening one-shot burst with Blade Waltz plus crit items

runes.keystoneWhy: The ramping attack speed rewards exactly the long trades you're trying to force; the longer Fiora's Riposte sits on cooldown (as low as 6s at rank 5), the more your stacked attack speed outpaces her short burst windows.

summoners.why: This pairing posts the best measured win rate in this matchup at 57.1%. Exhaust directly neutralizes her all-in burst from Lunge resets, Burst of Speed, and Blade Waltz, which is exactly the damage spike you're otherwise exposed to between levels 6 and 10.

playing.title: Bait Riposte before engaging
playing.detail: Poke with a minion auto or your E first; only commit Q or an auto-attack once you've seen her Riposte (W) trigger or its cooldown run out, since swinging into it gets parried and reflected.

playing.title: Lead trades with E, not Q
playing.detail: Sky Splitter's 1200 range outranges her 600-range Lunge entirely. Land it on her before she can close distance so you collect the slow and shield without ever offering her a Riposte target.

playing.title: Double-tap W for sustain
playing.detail: Mark her with the first Frenzied Maul, then immediately recast it on the same target for bonus damage and a heal. This is your primary tool for out-sustaining her Duelist regen in close trades.

playing.title: Save Q for her committed Lunge
playing.detail: She can't Riposte your stun mid-dash. If she burns both charges of Lunge to close or poke, her Riposte is now her only defensive tool left; punish immediately with Q.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-10 all-in window
playing.detail: Blade Waltz hits every nearby champion and resets Burst of Speed on a kill. Don't extend solo trades here; your Stormbringer is still on a 160s cooldown at rank 1 and isn't a reliable bailout yet.

playing.title: Hold R to zone, not to chase
playing.detail: Stormbringer slows and disables nearby towers on landing. Use it to force a bad trade near your own turret rather than diving after her, since a whiffed 160/135/110s-cooldown ultimate is a long window to play without it.

playing.title: Close the gap at level 11+
playing.detail: Once Statikk Shiv and Navori Flickerblade are online, your auto-W-auto rotation starts out-damaging her flat Lunge hits over the course of a fight. This is where the matchup tips back in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are pulled from measured games on the current patch (123 head-to-head games, 8,888 Volibear games overall); the mechanical reasoning and trade-window calls are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Always be aware of Fiora’s Riposte (W) before charging in using [Q]. Be careful of your Vitals when farming lane, and use [E] to contest lane while waiting for a chance to kill her.
